# rag-ferrite

> Personal RAG engine — simple, fast, Rust. One binary (15 MB), one DB, native collections. MCP-native.

## What it does

Turns your documents into queryable knowledge with semantic understanding, not just keyword matching.
Single Rust binary, SQLite storage, multi-collection, hybrid search.

## Key features

- Hybrid search (BM25 + HNSW vector + RRF fusion)
- LLM-powered ingestion: relevance scoring, contextual retrieval, auto-tagging
- Query pipeline: classification, expansion, reranking, corrective RAG
- 9 MCP tools (query, ingest, delete, list, status, benchmark, etc.)
- Single 15 MB binary, zero dependencies
- One-line install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lelabdev/rag-ferrite/main/install.sh | bash`

## Install

```bash
# One-line install
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lelabdev/rag-ferrite/main/install.sh | bash

# Or build from source
git clone https://github.com/lelabdev/rag-ferrite.git
cd rag-ferrite && cargo build --release
```

## Configuration

Requires an LLM provider and an embedding provider (any OpenAI-compatible API).

```toml
# config.toml
data_dir = "./data"

[embedding]
provider = "openai"
model = "qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b"
dimensions = 4096
base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"

[llm]
provider = "ollama"
model = "gemma4:31b"
base_url = "https://api.ollama.com"
context_enabled = true
relevance_scoring = true
```

## MCP Tools

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `query_documents(query, collection?, limit?)` | Hybrid search with optional collection filter |
| `ingest_file(file_path, collection?)` | Ingest PDF/TXT/MD |
| `ingest_data(content, source, collection?, format?)` | Ingest raw text or markdown |
| `delete_file(source)` | Remove document by source identifier |
| `list_files()` | List indexed documents |
| `status()` | Engine status and document count |
| `read_chunk_neighbors(source_id, chunk_index)` | Expand context around a chunk |
| `check_ingestion(file_path?, content?, source_name?)` | Preview document quality before ingestion |
| `benchmark(file_path, collection?, limit?)` | Evaluate retrieval quality against a golden dataset |

## Architecture

```
Ingestion: Document → Extract → Chunk (800 chars) → Relevance scoring (LLM)
         → Context prefix (LLM) → Auto-tag (LLM) → Embed → SQLite + HNSW + BM25

Query: Query → Classify → [Expand] → Hybrid search (BM25 + vector + RRF)
     → [Rerank] → Quality gate → [Reformulate + retry] → Results
```

## Stack

- Rust + axum + rmcp (MCP)
- SQLite + HNSW (rag_engine crate)
- Any OpenAI-compatible LLM and embedding provider
- License: MIT
